sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Wing 5's capstone fight — built around protecting friendly Reaper allies (that carry the squad's real damage) while managing Dhuum's own kill mechanics, on top of a pre-phase where the Reapers get swarmed before he even leaves his throne. Two-stage enrage.

sections.heading: Pre-phase (before ~8:00)
bullets: Enforcers spawn in the four corners in clockwise order from orbs traveling out of the throne, and hit the Reapers hard — catching those orbs in the air prevents the spawn in the first place.

Messengers spawn on a similar timer; small Deathling spiders also go after the Reapers but die easily. The Reapers have a x100 incoming-healing modifier during this window, so healing them is far more efficient than it looks.

Arcing Affliction (bombs): starting at 9:00, one player is tagged every 90 seconds — either wait out the 13-second timer and it detonates near allies, or use the special action key to pop it deliberately. The tag passes to the next non-debuffed player 3 seconds later.

sections.heading: Greens (protecting the Reapers)
bullets: Every 30 seconds Dhuum reaches for a friendly Reaper, telegraphed by a large green circle — a player must stand in it or the Reaper dies.
Standing in it lifts you skyward, where you have 15 seconds to catch 5 red orbs to come back down safely.
This rotates across 3+ players (commonly called G1/G2/G3) — a Fractured Spirit buff prevents you from taking two Greens in a row, so know your rotation.

sections.heading: Death Mark & Soul Shackle
bullets: <mark>Death Mark</mark>: Dhuum slams his scythe down on a random player with a large orange circle — anyone caught has their soul ripped out and must sprint back to their pillar of light within 10 seconds or die. <mark>Greater Death Mark</mark> is the same idea but also pulls targets toward him first, applies torment, and strips boons.

<mark>Soul Shackle</mark> (from 60%): the two non-tank players closest to Dhuum get tethered together (yellow border, red tether) — 4 seconds later the shackle activates and deals heavy damage unless you've already run in opposite directions to separate. Greater Death Mark also breaks an active shackle.
<mark>Cataclysmic Cycle</mark>: pulls the squad toward him — anyone who can't escape gets consumed. Dodge or displace out rather than trying to walk against the pull.
Face Dhuum with your back to a wall when he reappears for Death Mark / Greater Death Mark — it reduces how far the knockback throws you.

sections.heading: Messengers
bullets: These adds fixate on whoever attacks them first and die on their own 15 seconds after fixating — a dedicated kiter should grab one and run it around the arena so it doesn't chew through the friendly Reapers instead.

sections.heading: The 10% phase
bullets: Once Dhuum hits 10%, the timer resets to the hard 1:45 window. He lifts the whole squad to the ceiling and soul-splits everyone — each player needs to collect 5 orbs in 30 seconds to come back down.

After landing, the squad starts in a protective bubble at the center — spread out to the 7 Reaper Seals and interact with them. All 7 need to be activated within 10 seconds of the first one, so this needs to be called and executed as a group, not trickled in.
That opens a 20-second window to damage Dhuum before he goes invulnerable again — the cycle (lift → orbs → seals → burst) repeats until he's dead or the 1:45 runs out, which is a wipe.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 10:00 soft enrage from 100%→10% (Dhuum's damage jumps +500%), then a hard 1:45 window from 10%→0% (see above) that wipes the squad outright if it expires.
